# blindsndrapery.com
> blindsndrapery.com supplies and installs custom blinds, shades, shutters and drapery across Broward, Miami-Dade and Palm Beach counties, with statewide coverage in Florida for commercial projects. Every project starts with a free in-home consultation and measurement, and the written quote is based on those measurements.

## About
blindsndrapery.com is a Florida window covering company serving both residential and commercial customers, from a single bedroom to a multi-unit development.

The defining feature of how the business operates is that the whole job runs under one contract. Measurement, fabrication, installation and warranty all sit with the company. Most window covering suppliers leave the customer managing handovers between a salesperson, a measurer and a fitting company, and when something does not line up the customer is the one making the calls. Here there is a single point of contact from first enquiry to final fitting, and one company answerable for the result.

The process is straightforward. A short enquiry comes in and is answered within one business day. A local technician visits the property at a convenient time, brings the full range of fabric, timber and composite samples, talks through the options in the room they are intended for, and measures every opening precisely. A detailed written quote follows, based on the actual measurements rather than an approximation, which is why the figure does not move afterwards. Treatments are then made to those exact dimensions and professionally installed, with the work warranty-backed.

Material specification is driven by the Florida climate. Permanent humidity swells anything that absorbs moisture, salt air corrodes unrated hardware, and direct sun degrades poor finishes within two seasons. Composites, moisture-stable materials and corrosion-rated components are specified where standard products would fail.

## Services

### Blinds
Custom blinds built for Florida conditions, giving light control by the degree.
- Faux wood: engineered composite that will not swell, warp or blister in humidity. The correct specification for bathrooms, kitchens, laundries and rooms near a pool door.
- Aluminum: the thinnest profile in the range and completely unaffected by moisture, holding a straight line across a wide span without sagging.
- Vertical: for sliding doors and wide runs of glass where a horizontal system would stack too heavily at the head.
- Mini: narrow slats for tight reveals, small casements and transom windows.

### Shades
Five collections, each solving a different problem.
- Roller shades: the cleanest line available, rolling into a slim cassette. Light-filtering through to blackout, including dual systems carrying two fabrics on one bracket and banded options.
- Solar shades: engineered mesh that stops ultraviolet light and radiant heat at the glass while staying transparent enough to keep the view. Specified by openness factor, elevation by elevation.
- Cellular shades: honeycomb construction trapping still air against the glass, the most thermally efficient fabric option. Single cell for a slimmer stack, double cell for maximum insulation and sound absorption.
- Roman shades: heavier fabric folding into deep horizontal pleats. Natural weaves, structured cottons and blackout linings, in flat, hobbled and London fold styles.
- Zebra shades: alternating sheer and opaque bands that align or offset as the shade moves, switching between filtered daylight and full privacy without raising anything.

### Drapery and Curtains
Soft treatments cut, lined and hung to the ceiling height of the room.
- Custom drapery: full-length panels in a range of fabric weights, dressed on site so the folds fall correctly.
- Sheer curtains: lightweight fabric that diffuses daylight without closing a room down.
- Blackout curtains: any fabric lined for full room darkening, with the room-side face unchanged.
- Layered treatments: a sheer inner panel with a heavier outer curtain, separating the daytime job from the night-time one.
- Valances and cornices: soft fabric or structured upholstered headings that conceal the track.
Heading styles include pinch pleat, ripple fold and grommet. Motorized drapery tracks are available on any specification, and contract-grade flame-retardant fabrics are available for commercial work.

### Shutters
Interior shutters built into the opening rather than placed over it, insulating and permanent.
- Composite: will not warp, crack, swell or blister in permanent humidity. The correct specification for bathrooms, kitchens, laundries and any opening taking salt air.
- Wood: natural timber taking a stain with a depth engineered materials do not reproduce, for dry conditioned rooms.
- Vinyl: the most moisture-tolerant option, with a reinforced core, for utility openings and the wettest rooms.
Configurations include full-height for a single clean run, café-style covering the lower sash only, and tier-on-tier where upper and lower sections operate independently.

### Motorized and Smart Home
Automation for any treatment in the range.
- Motorized shades: roller, solar, cellular, roman and zebra.
- Smart blinds: tilt motors that angle slats without raising the blind, with lift automation on the same unit.
- Voice control through Alexa, Google Home and Apple HomeKit.
- App control from a phone or tablet, with saved positions.
- Scheduled automation tied to the clock or to sunrise and sunset, closing ahead of the afternoon peak.
Power options are rechargeable battery wands lasting nine to twelve months with no wiring required, or hardwired low-voltage systems where walls are open during a build or renovation.

### Repairs and Maintenance
On-site repair across the service area, with most jobs completed in a single visit.
- Shades: failed roller clutches, re-cording cellular and roman shades, damaged cassettes and fascia.
- Blinds: venetian blind restringing, bent or broken slat replacement, tilt mechanism and wand replacement, vertical vane and carrier replacement.
- Shutters: cracked louvers, tension correction, tilt rod repair, panel re-hanging.
- Motorized systems: battery wand replacement, motor diagnosis, remote and hub reprogramming.
Every major brand is serviced, including treatments supplied by other companies. Scheduled commercial maintenance contracts are available for offices, hospitality and multi-family properties.

### Commercial
Contract-grade window coverings across Florida.
- Offices: glare control for screen-facing workspaces, in mechanisms rated for far heavier cycling than domestic equivalents.
- Hospitality: genuine blackout for guest sleep quality, fabric that survives daily handling, and consistency across dozens of identical openings.
- Healthcare: privacy at eye level without a closed-in feel, on surfaces that wipe clean.
- Retail and multi-family: glare control that protects stock from ultraviolet fading, volume pricing and phased installation across occupied units.
Fabrics are available to NFPA 701 fire code standard where required, with certification supplied at handover. A dedicated project manager runs the job from survey to handover, pricing from window schedules, architectural drawings or a formal RFP.

## The Process
1. Send a short enquiry describing the rooms and roughly what is needed.
2. A response follows within one business day to arrange a convenient time.
3. A local technician visits with the full sample range and measures every opening precisely. A detailed written quote follows, based on those measurements.
4. Once the quote is agreed, treatments are made to those exact dimensions.
5. Professional installation, levelled, tested and warranty-backed.

There is no instant online pricing. The written quote follows the in-home measurement, so the figure given is based on the actual windows.

## Service Area

### Broward County
Fort Lauderdale, Coral Springs, Deerfield Beach, Hollywood, Pompano Beach, Plantation, Weston, Pembroke Pines, Davie, Sunrise, Coconut Creek and Miramar. Coastal properties from Deerfield down through Hollywood need corrosion-rated hardware and moisture-stable materials that inland communities do not.

### Miami-Dade County
Miami, Miami Beach, Coral Gables, Aventura, Doral, Kendall, Hialeah, North Miami, Sunny Isles Beach and Homestead. A significant share of the work is high-rise and condominium, where building access hours and management approval shape the schedule. Floor-to-ceiling glazing on east and south elevations makes solar shading the usual specification.

### Palm Beach County
Boca Raton, Delray Beach, West Palm Beach, Boynton Beach, Jupiter, Wellington and Palm Beach Gardens. The widest range of property types of the three counties, from waterfront estates to equestrian properties and dense multi-family developments.

### Statewide
Commercial installations and multi-unit developments anywhere in Florida.
